steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Keep the project configured with its Auction stage.
Apply the first available Auction template.
Add the required single line item.
Invite two QA vendors, corresponding to Vendor A and Vendor B without inventing names.
Commit a four-hour equivalent duration; 240 minutes represents 4 Hrs even though the preset label itself cannot be asserted.
Publish the configured eRFX Auction event.
Confirm publication reached a real project page.
Confirm Project Details exposes the bidding end timestamp for schedule verification.
